description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership information, and cadastral references. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
